method: linear cantilever screening, NOT full structure verification

rows.name: pelvis output web, weak-axis strip
rows.scope: 1.2 Nm root moment; angle fold and tapered root not represented; critical lower section still needs CAD section analysis

rows.name: pelvis rear frame, isolated web
rows.scope: full 2.45 kg at k=2 applied to one cantilever; actual multi-point load distribution unknown

rows.name: leg one of two webs, weak-axis strip
rows.scope: equal load sharing assumed; paired frame action, axial loading and spacers not represented

rows.name: arm link web, weak-axis strip
rows.scope: 1.2 Nm screening moment; actual angle section and case grip unresolved

rows.name: leg drive-side web, in-plane full torque
rows.scope: full 1.2 Nm carried by drive plate; passive rear disc does not halve drive torque

rows.name: foot toe-edge concentrated load
rows.scope: 48.07 N at toe edge, 58 mm lever; net section through both windows; stress concentrations and actual ground-pressure distribution excluded

rows.name: gripper finger, out-of-plane misuse load
rows.scope: contact-force magnitude applied to weak axis; normal grip acts mainly in plane, lateral object loads may not

rows.name: gripper finger, in-plane ideal strip
rows.scope: straight moving finger approximation; fixed return-shaped finger needs separate analysis

grip_100g_mu03_k2.assumes: two opposed contacts, Coulomb friction, force normal to jaw; no wedging or object eccentricity

unverified: hole bearing/net section and stress concentration
angle section torsion and local buckling
plastic case crush, creep and clamp slip
gripper contact overlap and pad bond
neck and foot detailed load paths
torso tube joints and threaded rod preload
complete mass and centre of gravity
fatigue, impact and continuous pose envelope
interpretation: A failed strip screen flags a load-path question; it does not prove the actual braced assembly fails. A passed strip screen does not certify the assembly.
